verses.en: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
verses.pt: Pelo que, não podendo mais suportar o cuidado por vós, achamos por bem ficar sozinhos em Atenas,
verses.en_web: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,
verses.en_bbe: At last our desire to have news of you was so strong that, while we ourselves were waiting at Athens,

verses.en: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
verses.pt: e enviamos Timóteo, nosso irmão, e ministro de Deus no evangelho de Cristo, para vos fortalecer e vos exortar acerca da vossa fé;
verses.en_web: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith;
verses.en_bbe: We sent Timothy, our brother and God's servant in the good news of Christ, to give you strength and comfort in your faith;

verses.en: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
verses.pt: para que ninguém seja abalado por estas tribulações; porque vós mesmo sabeis que para isto fomos destinados;
verses.en_web: that no one be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
verses.en_bbe: So that no man might be moved by these troubles; because you see that these things are part of God's purpose for us.

verses.en: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
verses.pt: pois, quando estávamos ainda convosco, de antemão vos declarávamos que havíamos de padecer tribulações, como sucedeu, e vós o sabeis.
verses.en_web: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.
verses.en_bbe: And when we were with you, we said to you that trouble was before us; and so it came about, as you see.

verses.en: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
verses.pt: Por isso também, não podendo eu esperar mais, mandei saber da vossa fé, receando que o tentador vos tivesse tentado, e o nosso trabalho se houvesse tornado inútil.
verses.en_web: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, when I was no longer able to keep quiet, I sent to get news of your faith, fearing that you might be tested by the Evil One and that our work might come to nothing.

verses.en: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
verses.pt: Mas agora que Timóteo acaba de regressar do vosso meio, trazendo-nos boas notícias da vossa fé e do vosso amor, dizendo que sempre nos tendes em afetuosa lembrança, anelando ver-nos assim como nós também a vós;
verses.en_web: But when Timothy came just now to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you;
verses.en_bbe: But now that Timothy has come to us from you, and has given us good news of your faith and love, and that you have happy memories of us, desiring greatly to see us, even as we do to see you;

verses.en: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
verses.pt: por isso, irmãos, em toda a nossa necessidade e tribulação, ficamos consolados acerca de vós, pela vossa fé,
verses.en_web: for this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause, brothers, in all our trouble and grief we were comforted about you because of your faith;

verses.en: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
verses.pt: porque agora vivemos, se estais firmes no Senhor.
verses.en_web: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: For it is life to us if you keep your faith in the Lord unchanged.

verses.en: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
verses.pt: Pois, que ação de graças podemos render a Deus por vós, por todo o gozo com que nos regozijamos por vossa causa diante do nosso Deus,
verses.en_web: For what thanksgiving can we render again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God;
verses.en_bbe: For how great is the praise which we give to God for you, and how great the joy with which we are glad because of you before our God;

verses.en: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
verses.pt: rogando incessantemente, de noite e de dia, para que possamos ver o vosso rosto e suprir o que falta à vossa fé?
verses.en_web: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
verses.en_bbe: Night and day requesting God again and again that we may see your face and make your faith complete.

verses.en: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
verses.pt: Ora, o próprio Deus e Pai nosso e o nosso Senhor Jesus nos abram o caminho até vós,
verses.en_web: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you;
verses.en_bbe: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus make a way for us to come to you;

verses.en: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
verses.pt: e o Senhor vos faça crescer e abundar em amor uns para com os outros e para com todos, como também nós abundamos para convosco;
verses.en_web: and the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord give you increase of love in fullest measure to one another and to all men, even as our love to you;

verses.en: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
verses.pt: para vos confirmar os corações, de sorte que sejam irrepreensíveis em santidade diante de nosso Deus e Pai, na vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus com todos os seus santos.
verses.en_web: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
verses.en_bbe: So that your hearts may be strong and free from all sin before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
